claims.disproof_condition: Downgrade if Broadcom's fourth-generation CPO moves off COUPE to another photonics process, or if either camp qualifies a second photonics foundry platform at volume.
claims.statement: Broadcom (customer side) publicly named TSMC COUPE as the optical-engine technology heterogeneously integrated in its shipping TH6-Davisson CPO switch — combined with NVIDIA's Quantum-X/Spectrum-X use of COUPE, TSMC's COUPE process now serves both major CPO switch camps, a cross-camp process-level concentration one hop below the demand anchors.

claims.disproof_condition: Downgrade if shipment claims are contradicted by customer-side deployment evidence or the product is recalled/respun.
claims.statement: TH6-Davisson (BCM78919) is shipping as of 2025-10-08: 102.4 Tbps via 16 Davisson DR optical engines (6.4T each) at 200 Gbps per link, with field-replaceable ELSFP laser modules — Broadcom's third-generation CPO switch, doubling TH5-Bailly line rate (issuer self-reported shipping/performance claims).

claims.disproof_condition: Revise if future generations integrate lasers on-package (removing the pluggable socket), or if one supplier wins exclusive ELSFP qualification at either camp.
claims.statement: Both CPO camps externalize lasers as field-replaceable pluggable modules (Broadcom: ELSFP; NVIDIA: front-panel ELS OSFP) — the laser socket is architecturally standardized and replaceable by design, which shapes substitutability for laser-module suppliers (a competitive socket, not a designed-in monopoly).

source_doc.title: Broadcom Announces Tomahawk 6 – Davisson, the Industry's First 102.4-Tbps Ethernet Switch with Co-Packaged Optics

sources.quote: By heterogeneously integrating TSMC Compact Universal Photonic Engine (TSMC COUPE™) technology-based optical engines with advanced substrate-level multi-chip packaging, the switch dramatically reduces the need for signal conditioning and minimizes trace loss and reflections.
Broadcom Inc. (NASDAQ: AVGO) today announced that it is now shipping Tomahawk® 6 – Davisson (TH6-Davisson), the company's third-generation Co-Packaged Optics (CPO) Ethernet switch.
102.4 Tbps Switching Capacity 16 x 6.4 Tbps Davisson DR Optical Engines 200 Gbps per link bandwidth Field-Replaceable ELSFP Laser Modules
Broadcom is now developing its fourth-generation CPO solution. The new generation will double per-channel bandwidth to 400 Gbps while achieving greater levels of energy efficiency
